info.desc: Wildheart is the third studio album by American R&B singer Miguel. He produced the album with Benny Cassette, Cashmere Cat, Benny Blanco, and Salaam Remi, among others, while collaborating with fellow singer Lenny Kravitz and rapper Kurupt on certain songs. The record finds Miguel departing further from modern R&B with rock styles such as psychedelic and new wave, as well as lyrical themes that explore morality, normalcy, and sexuality. RCA Records and ByStorm Entertainment released the album on June 29, 2015. Wildheart charted at number two on the Billboard 200 while selling 40,500 copies in its first week. It was .
